description: This file defines an Android activity called UnicodeChart that displays a chart of Unicode characters, allowing navigation between different Unicode blocks via key events.

classes.name: UnicodeChart
classes.description: Main activity class that initializes and sets the custom view displaying Unicode characters.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View that handles rendering the Unicode chart and user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets no title feature, and attaches the custom Unicode chart view.

methods.name: SampleView <init>
methods.description: Constructor initializes paints, character array, position array, and configurations.

methods.name: computeX
methods.description: Calculates the X coordinate for a given character index.

methods.name: computeY
methods.description: Calculates the Y coordinate for a given character index.

methods.name: drawChart
methods.description: Draws the Unicode characters and labels on the canvas for a given Unicode block base.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the entire chart on the canvas, called during the view's rendering cycle.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles left/right key events to change Unicode block base and refresh view.
